imageGeneration.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. A cinematic close-up of an unbranded football on the edge of a floodlit stadium pitch at night, dark midnight blue atmosphere, cyan and violet lighting aligned with a modern sports analytics brand. L’IA.'; subheadline 'Analyses +0,5 but • Vote de 5 IA'; smaller support line 'Historique transparent : gains et pertes visibles'; offer in clear badge 'PREMIUM • 14,90 €/mois'; CTA 'DÉCOUVRIR TOUSLESMATCHS.COM'; readable bottom footer '18+ • Aucun gain garanti • joueurs-info-service.fr'.
